name: Dawn's Return
description:
Fast Action: Equip this to your Varka and create Windbound Execution.
After your Varka uses a Normal Attack: Grant Cost Reduction to 1 Windbound Execution in your Hand.
(You must have Varka in your deck to add this card to your deck.)

storytext: "I'm sure it's painfully obvious to every reader by now, but the 'Witch Certification and Final Trial' mentioned in Volume 1 of the original work can only be taken by children who wish to become great witches. In other words, you can't have a 'Witch Certification Exam' without witches. Surely no one would use the certification exam as an excuse to give themselves a task they've already completed just to go around swindling people out of free drinks, right?"
